title: A decision or a move back leaves the person's held slots held
body:
## Summary
Propose slots now holds time only for someone at Interview (6eb64a8), but a hold made there survives the person leaving Interview: a decision (offer, rejection) or a move back to Screening leaves their three slots `proposed` for someone who can no longer be booked into them.

## Description
examples/hirelane/app/actions.ts:202 `decideStage` and :306 `sendRejection` write the stage and never touch `slots`; :183 `moveStage` accepts `screening` from `interview` (it 'goes back', its own docstring says) and leaves holds in place. After any of the three, `scheduleReason` refuses booking for that person (decided / too_early), and `canBook` refuses everyone else (held for someone else), so the slots are locked until somebody finds and undoes the original propose row. This is the second half of the rule 6eb64a8 built: a hold exists only for someone who can be booked into it. Fixed looks like: the stage-changing writes release the person's `proposed` (never `booked`) slots in the same transaction and say so in the activity summary; a move's undo re-holds nothing (the propose row's own undo already reports a partial release).

## Flow
- agent proposes three slots for an Interview candidate -> holds 3
- a person sends the rejection -> stage rejected, the 3 slots still `proposed` for them
- any other Interview candidate -> those 3 slots are not bookable (held for someone else) and not proposable (not free)
- fix: one helper in lib/acts.ts or actions.ts that releases `status='proposed' AND applicant_id=?` on decideStage, sendRejection and a moveStage below interview; tests in test/actions.test.ts

## Expected impact
Recruiters and agents stop losing calendar time to people who left Interview; measured as slots `proposed` for non-Interview people after one decision. Could break: the undo of the original propose_slots row, which must keep reporting a partial release honestly.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no slot stays held for a person who cannot be booked into it
Before: 3 of 3 slots stay held after a rejection of a person holding them (walked from actions.ts:202-226 and :306-334; no slots write in either)
After: predicted 0 of 3
Method: simulation - actions.ts is granted to this round only for the assigned propose item, so the fix and its red test belong to a worker that owns the server actions
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence:
examples/hirelane/app/actions.ts:202  export async function decideStage(...)  - writeStage + logActivity, no slots write
examples/hirelane/app/actions.ts:306  export async function sendRejection(...)  - writeStage + messages + logActivity, no slots write
examples/hirelane/app/actions.ts:183  moveStage: isMoveStage('screening') admits interview -> screening
examples/hirelane/lib/acts.ts  scheduleReason(stage) -> 'decided' | 'too_early' for every non-Interview stage
instrument: test/actions.test.ts: propose 3 for an Interview candidate, reject them, count slots proposed for them (expect 0, today 3); same after a move back to screening

title: A second scheduling email books a second interview for a person already booked
body:
## Summary
`send_scheduling_email` books and emails any bookable slot for a person at Interview, including one who already has a booked, emailed interview; the first booking stays booked and the person receives two invitations.

## Description
examples/hirelane/app/actions.ts `sendSchedulingEmail` checks `scheduleReason` (stage) and `canBook` (slot), never whether this applicant already holds a `booked` slot; examples/hirelane/lib/acts.ts `actsFor().schedule` offers it on the same terms. Every seeded Interview candidate already has a booked slot (lib/db.ts seedSlots books the n=2 slot of each interviewer for them), so the dossier's gated Send offers a second interview to all five, and test/actions.test.ts:65 ('scheduling works at Interview') pins exactly that: it sends to `pick('interview')`, who is already booked. The act is GATED and irreversible, the old booking is never released, and nothing on the card says one was already sent beyond 'Already sent'. Fixed looks like: either refuse with a reason (`already_booked`, naming the time) and offer a reschedule as its own act, or make the send a reschedule that releases the old slot and says so in the mail - a product call between the two.

## Flow
- open a seeded Interview candidate's dossier -> Send a scheduling email is enabled
- arm and fire -> a second slot is booked, a second invitation goes out; the first slot stays booked
- fix: an `already_booked` reason in lib/acts.ts read by actsFor and the action, or a reschedule act; tests rewritten where they pin the double booking

## Expected impact
A candidate stops receiving two interview times for one interview and an interviewer's slot stops being locked by a superseded booking; measured as people with two booked slots after one journey. Could break: the journey's beat 8 if it ever schedules a seeded candidate (today it schedules two freshly moved ones).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - one interview booking per person unless a reschedule is chosen
Before: 5 of 5 seeded Interview candidates can be sent a second interview (actsFor schedule enabled; test/actions.test.ts:65 does it)
After: predicted 0 of 5 without an explicit reschedule
Method: simulation - the action and acts.ts are outside this round's write set except for the assigned item, and refuse-vs-reschedule is a product choice the worker should confirm
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence:
examples/hirelane/lib/db.ts:423  const takeBooking = bookedLeft > 0 && n === 2;  (every seeded interview candidate gets a booked slot)
examples/hirelane/test/actions.test.ts:65-74  sendSchedulingEmail(pick('interview').id, openSlot().id) -> ok true, a second booking
examples/hirelane/lib/acts.ts actsFor: schedule enabled whenever stage is interview and a bookable slot exists
instrument: test/actions.test.ts: send to a seeded (already booked) Interview candidate and count their booked slots (today 2, expect 1 or a refusal); the acts parity matrix with the new reason

title: Interview slots are not scoped to the role whose interviewers they belong to
body:
## Summary
The seed draws three interviewers per role and books each role's Interview candidates with that role's own interviewers, but Propose slots and the dossier's slot list offer every free slot, so a Backend candidate can be held and booked with a Product Designer interviewer.

## Description
examples/hirelane/lib/db.ts:408 `seedSlots(db, rng, roleId, index, today)` draws `interviewers` per role and books only that role's interview applicants into them (slot ids `slot_1xx` backend, `slot_2xx` designer); the `slots` table (db.ts:68) has no role column, so examples/hirelane/lib/acts.ts `isFree` / `bookableSlots` / `slotsToHold` and actions.ts `proposeSlots` cannot ask whose panel a slot is on. The scheduling mail then names that interviewer to the candidate. Fixed looks like: a `role_id` on slots (seeded from the role the interviewer was drawn for, without moving the rng stream), and the slot predicates filtered by the person's role.

## Flow
- agent proposes slots for a Backend Interview candidate -> the three earliest free slots, any role's
- the earliest free slot is a designer interviewer's -> held, then emailed: 'with <designer interviewer>'
- fix: slots.role_id + the role filter in lib/acts.ts and allSlots; seed test that the stream is unchanged

## Expected impact
Candidates are interviewed by the panel for the role they applied to; measured as held or booked slots whose interviewer belongs to another role. Could break: the seed's byte-stable stream if the role is drawn rather than derived.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a slot is offered only to candidates of the role its interviewer was drawn for
Before: slots carry no role (0 of 36); the seed books role-matched, the actions offer all 36 to everyone
After: predicted 36 of 36 slots role-scoped, offers filtered
Method: simulation - a schema, seed and acts change across lib/db.ts, lib/acts.ts and app/actions.ts; the last two are outside this round's set beyond the assigned item
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
examples/hirelane/lib/db.ts:410  const interviewers = [rng.fullName(), rng.fullName(), rng.fullName()];  (per role)
examples/hirelane/lib/db.ts:411  booked = applicants WHERE role_id = ? AND stage = 'interview'
examples/hirelane/lib/db.ts:68-75  CREATE TABLE slots (... no role_id ...)
examples/hirelane/lib/acts.ts isFree/bookableSlots: no role argument
instrument: test/acts.test.ts: for every applicant, every slot actsFor offers (schedule.slots, slotsToHold) has the applicant's role; today 0 slots carry a role

title: The dossier and the slide print a booked interview as 'Time held'
body:
## Summary
The board's interview facts read `meta.held`, which holds booked and proposed slots alike; the dossier labels them all 'Time held', the slide 'no slot held' or the list, and the column fact 'have a slot held', so a booked, emailed interview reads as a tentative hold.

## Description
examples/hirelane/components/board/dossier/Evidence.tsx:79 'Time held', examples/hirelane/components/board/carousel/StageMeta.tsx:39 and examples/hirelane/components/board/columns/facts.tsx:41 all print `meta.held` without its status. 99aeb97 added `status: 'held' | 'booked'` to every entry (and to the agent's `slots_held`), so the data now says which is which; the three surfaces are hirelane-board-ui's files and were not this round's to change. Fixed looks like: 'Booked' and 'Held' as two facts (or a status word per entry), and the column fact counting booked and held apart.

## Flow
- open a seeded Interview candidate -> 'Time held: <interviewer>, <time>' for an interview they have been emailed about
- fix: render `status` in Evidence.tsx and StageMeta.tsx; split the facts.tsx count

## Expected impact
A reader stops mistaking a confirmed interview for a hold they could still change; measured as booked slots rendered under a 'held' label. Could break: the slide's line length at L1.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the card says booked for a booked interview
Before: 5 of 5 seeded booked interviews render as 'held' on the dossier and the slide
After: predicted 0 of 5
Method: simulation - .tsx cannot be rendered by the package's test runner (the board-ui round's render-instrument card), and the files are another context's
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
examples/hirelane/components/board/dossier/Evidence.tsx:79  <dt>Time held</dt>
examples/hirelane/components/board/carousel/StageMeta.tsx:40  ? "no slot held"
examples/hirelane/components/board/columns/facts.tsx:42  `${held} of ${candidates.length} have a slot held`
examples/hirelane/components/board/model/candidates.ts BdStageMeta.held[].status (99aeb97)
instrument: a source read (as test/gate.test.ts does) or a happy-dom render asserting the dossier prints a booked entry as booked; today 0 surfaces read `status`

title: propose_slots' description omits who it holds for and the three-in-all limit
body:
## Summary
`propose_slots` now holds only for someone at Interview and tops a person up to three in all (6eb64a8), but the description an agent selects it by still reads 'Hold up to three open interview slots for an applicant'.

## Description
examples/hirelane/components/HostCapabilities.tsx:103-106. The refusals are diagnosable (REFUSAL.too_early says to move the person to Interview first; REFUSAL.already_held says three are held), so a wrong call recovers in one step, but mcp-tools/tool-schema-design asks that the description say when to use a tool, so the first call is right. Fixed looks like: 'Hold interview slots for an applicant at Interview, up to three in all; a second call tops them back up and never holds more. Nothing is sent.'

## Flow
- agent reads the description, calls propose_slots for an Applied candidate -> refused, too early
- fix: one description string in HostCapabilities.tsx, and a tools.test.ts assertion that it names Interview

## Expected impact
Agents stop spending a refused call on people below Interview; measured as refused propose_slots calls in a journey. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the agent's first propose_slots call is a legal one
Before: description names neither precondition (0 of 2)
After: predicted 2 of 2
Method: probe - read the description against proposeReason; HostCapabilities.tsx is hirelane-board-ui's file
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
examples/hirelane/components/HostCapabilities.tsx:105  "Hold up to three open interview slots for an applicant. Nothing is sent. ..."
examples/hirelane/lib/acts.ts proposeReason: scheduleReason ?? (heldFor >= SLOTS_HELD_EACH ? 'already_held' : ...)
instrument: test/tools.test.ts: the propose_slots description names Interview and the three-in-all limit
